content.description:
The content that corresponds to this vector. {@see #contentToEmbed}
e.g. "To address fault code AXZ, first replace part A...."

contentToEmbed.description:
The content that was passed to the embedding model to generate #embedding. This may differ from #content if
one wants to add additional context or metadata to actual source content in order to improve the quality of
similarity search.
e.g. "Excerpt from Boiler Repair Manual pdf: To address fault code AXZ, first replace part A..."

embedding.description:
The numeric content that similarity search is conducted on.
e.g. "[0.1, 0.05, 0.21, ...]"

source.description: The unique 'name' (often including complete path) of the source file, e.g. "/my/directory/boiler-repair-manual.pdf"

jobRunId.description: ID of the job run that generated the vector.

jobRunType.description: The type of the job run that generated the vector.

details.description:
Extra information associated with the vector.
NOTE: due to the free-form nature of this field, the values of the map are not indexed and therefore will not
be available for metadata filtering in {@link GenaiCore.SimilaritySearchSpec#metadataFilter}.

jobId.description:
ID of the parent job of the job run that generated the vector. This allows tracing the vector back to the
originating job if the job run has been cleaned up by `unstructured-job-run-cleanup`.

jobType.description: The type of the parent job of the job run that generated the vector.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

totalChunks.description: The number of chunks that was produced from the corresponding source.

chunkIndex.description: The index of this embedded chunk in the total number of chunks.

title: Test vector to be used with {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job}.
name: GenaiCore.TestChunkVector
